name: has_iron_law_exit_zero
pattern: NO COMPLETION CLAIM WITHOUT exit-0 CAPTURE

name: operational_agent_return_is_machine_contract
pattern: machine contract, not a progress update

name: operational_wrapper_does_not_forward_chatter
pattern: does not forward subagent preamble, epilogue, or incidental commentary

name: accepts_operational_completion_via_bundled_cli
why: Once the operational gate passes, task status plus both evidence events should be recorded by one CLI command instead of a hand-rolled status/event/event sequence.

name: operational_completion_avoids_handrolled_status_and_events
pattern: mark task `done`[\s\S]*events emit operational_task_completed[\s\S]*events emit task_dispatch_returned
why: The complete path should not regress to separate model-selected state mutations after the gate passes.

name: render_provenance_negation
why: v3.11.0 context-conflation fix: the render-before-ask rule must state the negative — Read results, subagent returns, dossier files, and SendMessage payloads are not 'shown to the user'. Anchors the same phrase check_render_before_ask requires.

name: render_before_ask_rule
why: v3.11.0: capability skills were out of scope in v3.8.0; any skill body mentioning AskUserQuestion now states the render-before-ask rule.

name: documents_rerun_failed_config_key
why: P2 fix (a 13-minute tier costs 26+ minutes on one failure, 39+ on two): the wrapper must name the config key that drives narrowed fix-loop reruns so a reader can find where the behavior is switched on.

name: documents_rerun_failed_absent_is_unchanged
why: P2 constraint: absent rerun_failed must leave today's full-rerun-every-iteration behavior byte-identical — Shipyard cannot know the user's runner, so narrowing is opt-in only. Pins that the wrapper states this explicitly rather than leaving it implicit.

name: documents_final_iteration_always_full
pattern: always runs the FULL verify command
why: P2 constraint: the loop may never exit green on a narrowed run, so the last iteration in the budget must be structurally reserved as a full-suite confirmation. Regression guard against silently letting the cap land on a narrowed attempt.

name: documents_narrowed_pass_is_not_proof
pattern: narrowed run that exits 0 is not proof
why: P2 constraint: a narrowed rerun_failed pass only proves the previously-failing subset now passes, not the whole suite. The agent must never let that short-circuit STATUS: COMPLETE — the structured return contract and the verification ledger both treat a recorded pass as authoritative, so a narrowed pass recorded as full would be a false green.

name: documents_no_argument_substitution
why: P2 constraint (config-driven, never inferred): the agent must run rerun_failed verbatim rather than parsing capture output to build a test-name filter — Shipyard cannot know the runner's failure-report format, and guessing one would be exactly the kind of inference this feature is designed to avoid.
